summary: A mixed legal and business day with important regulatory relief for employers, significant retail expansion plans, and continued India market interest from global players. Key focus on EPF cost reduction and e-commerce strategy shifts.

bullets.text: EPF inspection charge rate reduced from 0.35% to 0.18% of wages, lowering employer compliance costs significantly.
Amazon expands quick-commerce fashion offering via Amazon Now to 300 cities, reshaping e-commerce strategy.
Nestle CEO outlines major India investment roadmap, positioning nation as key player in global operations.
Reliance pursues AI roadmap with Jio CallAgent network integration, expanding telecom-AI convergence capabilities.
Google settles UK app developers lawsuit for $353 million over Play Store commission practices.
